items.proposed: CDKN2A_B, role enrichment, candidate_matched true, matched_agent prt3645
items.reason: 'CDKN2A/B homozygous deleted IDH-mutant astrocytoma' is required for one disease subgroup, not for all entrants, so enrichment fits better than eligibility; manual §5 lists 'CDKN2A loss + CDK4/6 inhibitor' as matched. But the requirement does not apply to the GBM entrants ('Recurrent GBM (IDH wild type)').

items.proposed: CDK4_6_pathway, role enrichment, candidate_matched true, matched_agent prt3645
items.reason: 'CDK pathway alternation in any of the following tumor types: malignant mesothelioma, HPV-negative HNSCC ... sarcoma, or NSCLC' is a subgroup requirement for a CDK4/6 inhibitor (matched). It does not apply to glioblastoma.

note: Policy question for XL that the manual and D30 rulings do not settle: in a basket trial, does candidate-matched selection count when it applies only to non-GBM participants? By the letter of manual §5 (any eligibility/enrichment row with candidate_matched true), candidate_matched_selection = true. If XL requires the selection to apply to the GBM entrants, it becomes false: GBM enters on 'Recurrent GBM (IDH wild type)' alone, and IDH-wildtype is never matched. Also, coders coded HR+ breast cancer as not matched; a CDK4/6 inhibitor is arguably matched to HR+ status, but the record states no link. any_molecular_selection stays true either way (HR/HER2, KRAS/SMARCA4, ER/TP53 subgroup requirements).
